title: Философский Взрыв
config_smoke: PASS: PIXELLAB_BEARER_TOKEN via env; python3 tools/pixellab_auth_smoke.py returned a JSON-RPC get_balance result without exposing credentials

create_params.description: dark fantasy pixel art alchemical ritual magic circle seen straight from above: a glowing pentagram of gold runes with five small round powder kegs sitting at its points, each keg glowing a different alchemical color, faint crystal shards rising at the rim, centered composition, isolated game VFX sprite, no characters, no text

animation.animation_description: the five powder kegs ignite one after another with colored sparks, the pentagram runes brighten and rotate slightly, then everything is pulled inward into a tight dark crystal at the center, and finally the crystal bursts into one big bright gold-white transmutation explosion with radiating light rays and drifting sparkles that fade out

reproducibility.replay_note: PIXELLAB_BEARER_TOKEN env + --object-id replays download/manifest only; fresh IDs come from a new create_1_direction_object run. PixelLab object auto-delete window is 8 hours; the downloaded frames in source/ are the durable record.

asset.frame_size: 256x256 RGBA, transparent background, stable identity across frames (same circle/keg pivots)
asset.normalized_by: bit-exact copy of the PixelLab frames (already 256x256 full-frame RGBA); no crop, no matte, no palette shift

windup.frames: 0-3 (kegs idle, then the five charges ignite one after another)

release.frames: 4-5 (pentagram brightens and rotates through the cast ceremony)

active.frames: 6-8 (inward crystal implosion into the gold-white transmutation blast)

recovery.frames: 8 held (radiance decays while the sigil sweeps outward and evaporates)

cancel.frames: alpha reaches zero; Timeline releases every handle

distinctness: acid_flask is one colossal emerald flask and a green lake; homunculus_vial is an emerald avatar fusion; blast_powder is the only gold-rune pentagram with five multicolor kegs and a gold-white crystal implosion blast

v2_presentation_rework.decision: the FAN-2550 PixelLab frames carry the v2 envelope: no new PixelLab job; beats re-spaced to 0.95/1.3/2.9/3.6s, arena-wide sigil scale, full-screen backdrop veil, hero glow, camera shake, 110ms hitstop and SFX ducking
